ThingDef.label: Unstable xenogerm
ThingDef.description:
A self-contained biological organ containing one or more implantable xenogenes.

Once implanted into a host, an unstable xenogerm uses viruses, hormones, biosynthetic drugs and possibly machinery to alter the host's genes, gene expression and phenotype development. Depending on the unstable xenogerm, the host develops a variety of strange traits and abilities, transforming into another human xenotype.

Implanting an unstable xenogerm is a traumatic process. Once implanted, a person will be bedridden for several days while the transformation completes, and will also carry multiple defective genes.

While in storage and transport, unstable xenogerms are kept safely inside sealed containers.
